hello new player here , this is my haul i like the tentacle and the blood mechanic , is there any balance for this , or is there a must to get/ aim for for new players , thank you <3

Saya and Pontos aren't exactly best friends, but I doubt you'll struggle for quite awhile slotting them with just some friends

Out of what you have right now, I like Faint, she gives counter weakness, death resist, adds to the -str scaling

With that team Pontos does fixed damage, so you don't benefit as much from vuln, and could run Goliath just for straight tentacle scaling, he isn't great himself, but his exalt at that level would give 40% tentacle damage as strength for the turn, giving you a burst on Pontos especially with Saya corrosion

Small nonbo that corrosion can eat kills from Pontos, if you have his wheel this means less exalts, but typically gaunt slay and his exalt will still scale his wheel easily enough AND she doesn't discard gaunts unfortunately 🙁

Who is dealing the damage and how? Ghelot, bloodthirsty flail
